annotations.title: Content moderation for up to 25 texts

description: Content moderation for up to 25 texts — Moderate up to 25 user posts, comments, reviews or messages in one call. texts = items separated by | or newlines, or a JSON array (each up to 1,000 chars). Categories: harassment, hate, violence, self_harm, sexual, sexual_minors, illicit, spam_scam, profanity, each with severity none/low/medium/high and a short reason. Model labels are snapped to the fixed set and backed by offline profanity, spam-phrase, link and shouting signals. Optional threshold (low, medium default, high) decides flagged; optional context (what platform). Verdict CLEAN / REVIEW / BLOCK_SOME with a category distribution. Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).

texts.description: e.g. Great product, fast shipping!|CLICK HERE to claim your FREE MONEY http://win.example|You are an idiot and everyone hates you

name: ai_moderate_batch
